one_liner: Klaviyo has a broad REST API with self-serve private API keys and self-serve OAuth app creation, free test accounts, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Private API keys (Klaviyo-API-Key header) with scopes, and OAuth authorization code with PKCE. OAuth apps can be created at klaviyo.com/oauth/client. Public site ID is only for client endpoints. The Conversations API is gated separately.
access_notes: The Get Started series creates a free test account. There are no platform or API usage fees. The free tier covers 250 profiles. Only the Conversations API needs approval, and it is a small part of the API.
blocker_notes: Marketplace listing needs partner approval, but building and testing do not. The Conversations API is gated.

evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).
